classes.title: How Little Duet works
classes.parentTip: Watch together once before your first class.

segments.caption: Sit together
segments.parentCue: Sit side by side, so you both see the screen
segments.voice: Hi, friends. I'm your music teacher. Let's get ready to play together.

segments.caption: Phone flat
segments.parentCue: Or stand it up sideways in a stand, so it cannot slide
segments.voice: Lay the phone flat on the table, like a little piano.

segments.caption: Sound on
segments.parentCue: Turn the phone sideways for a bigger piano
segments.voice: Grown-up, turn the sound up and switch off silent mode.

segments.caption: You play
segments.voice: You are the piano player today.

segments.caption: Grown-up helps
segments.parentCue: You never need to play perfectly
segments.voice: Grown-up, you are the helper. Point, cheer, and guide a finger when needed.

segments.caption: White and black keys
segments.voice: Here are the piano keys. Long white keys, and little black keys.

segments.caption: Two black keys
segments.voice: Find two black keys, side by side.

segments.caption: This is C
segments.parentCue: The same key is middle C on a real piano
segments.voice: Just to the left of them lives C, our home key.

segments.caption: One finger
segments.parentCue: On a tablet, small hands can rest a curved hand on the keys
segments.voice: Hold up your pointer finger. That's your tapping finger.

segments.caption: Gentle taps
segments.parentCue: One tap at a time. Resting a palm on the glass presses keys
segments.voice: Tap gently, like touching a bubble. Then lift your finger up.

segments.caption: Listen: C
segments.voice: Listen. This is how C sounds.

segments.caption: The glowing key
segments.voice: When a key glows, that's the key to tap.

segments.caption: Falling blocks
segments.parentCue: Coral blocks are your child's notes, blue ones play by themselves
segments.voice: Blocks fall down to the keys. When a block lands, tap.

segments.caption: Finger numbers
segments.parentCue: 1 is the thumb, 5 is the little finger, as on a real piano
segments.voice: The numbers are finger names. Your thumb is number one.

segments.caption: One to five
segments.parentCue: Touch each finger as you count
segments.voice: Wiggle each one with me. One, two, three, four, five.

segments.caption: Watch
segments.voice: When you see the eye, it's watch time. Hands in your lap.

segments.caption: Watch
segments.voice: Watch the key light up. Here I go.

segments.caption: Your turn
segments.voice: When you see the hand, it's your turn. I wait for your tap.

segments.caption: Together
segments.voice: When you see two friends, we play together, at the same time.

segments.caption: Bear low, bird high
segments.parentCue: Keys on the right sound high, like a little bird
segments.voice: Keys on the left sound low, like a big bear.

segments.caption: Bear! Tap down low
segments.parentCue: Any key on the left counts
segments.voice: Tap any key on the bear's side, on the left.

segments.caption: Bird! Tap up high
segments.parentCue: Any key on the right counts
segments.voice: Now the little bird. Tap any key on the right.

segments.caption: Tap the beat
segments.parentCue: Any key is fine on the beat
segments.voice: When the circle grows, tap any key. Tap, tap, tap.

segments.caption: Pause or stop
segments.parentCue: We save your place, so you can come back later
segments.voice: Grown-up, pause at the top any time. Close stops the class.

segments.caption: Stars
segments.voice: At the end of each class, you get stars for playing together.

segments.caption: Mistakes are fine
segments.parentCue: There is never a fail sound. Cheer for trying
segments.voice: Tap a different key, and it just makes its sound. Then try the glowing one.

segments.caption: Your first note
segments.voice: Now your very first note. Find C, our home key.

segments.caption: Your turn!
segments.parentCue: Point to C if your child needs help
segments.voice: Your turn. One gentle tap on C.

segments.caption: You did it!
segments.voice: You did it! You played your very first note.

segments.caption: Ready to play
segments.parentCue: Pick a song from Home to start your first class
segments.voice: That's how Little Duet works. Now let's play a song together.
